description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the CandidateShortlistingAPI within the OrangeHRM Recruitment API module. It contains unit tests for various methods of the API, primarily focusing on the 'getOne', 'getValidationRuleForGetOne', 'update', 'delete', and 'getValidationRuleForDelete' methods. The class extends EndpointIntegrationTestCase and sets up test data and mock services to verify the API behavior, verifying exception handling and update functionality.
